notes_for_editor: No build date for the Long Hollow tower appears in any source read, so the story starts in April 1942, when it was already manned. The main site-specific source is a 1942 Portsmouth Times report as reprinted on the Forest Lookouts Telegraph Hill page; the Long Hollow subpage on that site returns 404. The 1942 report says the cab was still to be installed, so the story says the Forest Service had received it and that CCC crews were to build it, without confirming it went up. Access is unknown and no source gives it. Brief checks: agency, elevation (305 m) and FFLOS registration date match; no corrections. Story body is about 240 words. Two WebSearch queries used.
